name: pedal-sorter-v3
preprocessing: RawImage.read on the whole photo, then the OWLv2 processor (pad to square, resize to 960, normalize). One model call per photo.
text_batch_note: The same 20 queries in the same order as the dev run, so every score is computed exactly as on dev. Only the 5 queries in the rule affect the call.
box_score: L(q) is the highest class logit for query q over all 3,600 boxes
score: L(chain) + max(L(bicycle), L(electric bicycle)) - max(L(motorcycle), L(dirt bike))
decision: pedals if score >= threshold, otherwise no pedals. Never an abstain. A photo with no score counts as wrong.
chosen_on: 71 dev photos only: the 12 v1 photos, the 35 photo-pilot-v2 train photos and the 24 spent photo-pilot-v2 test photos. 1,140 candidate rules. No trained weights, only the queries, the score form and the threshold were picked on dev.

bars.invented_facts: Zero class, watt or speed values reported when no label is visible

ocr_check: scripts/pilot-v2-ocr.ts (tesseract.js 7.0.0 eng plus lib/extract/parse.ts in label mode)
